name: Photo Effect Template (Live)
description: A real decision model applies one style across a photo set with a real image model, reviews every generation, regenerates a failed one at most once, and delivers one example per photo

config.instructions: You turn every photo of the input photo set into one stylized example in the style the creative brief asks for. The input is a JSON document with the brief and a list of photos, each identified by its photoAssetId. First write one settings object for the whole set: a prompt that describes the requested style and asks to keep each photo's subject, composition and identity recognizable, and resolution "1K". Add aspectRatio only when the brief asks for a specific shape. Use only the settings fields prompt, aspectRatio, resolution and seed, and do not set a seed. Reuse exactly the same settings object in every generate_image call, so every example shares one settings digest. For each photo in order, call generate_image with that photoAssetId and the shared settings, then call review_asset with the returned assetRef and the same photoAssetId, passing no other review argument. When a review fails, regenerate that photo once with the same settings and review the new image. Never regenerate a photo more than once, and never make more than 6 generate_image calls in total. After every photo has been generated and reviewed, finish with FINAL. The FINAL output must be a JSON string whose content is the JSON object {"examples":[{"photoAssetId":"...","assetRef":"..."}],"settingsDigest":"..."}: exactly one example per photo, using the image that passed review or otherwise the newest image for that photo, and the settingsDigest that generate_image returned.
